user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Create a dedicated API key with only user.read, album.read, asset.read, and asset.view.

data_description.url: HTTPS, local HTTP, Tailscale IP, and MagicDNS hostnames are supported. A trailing /api is accepted.
data_description.api_key: The key is sent only in the x-api-key header.
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled unless the server deliberately uses a trusted private certificate.

sources.title: Choose image sources
sources.description: Each enabled source creates one image entity.

data.include_library: Random image from the whole library

data_description.repeat_window: Remember this many images per source to reduce repeats. Use 0 to disable.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Immich API key
reauth_confirm.description: Use a key for the same Immich user with only user.read, album.read, asset.read, and asset.view.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the Immich server
reconfigure.description: Change the server address or TLS verification without replacing the API key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Immich server.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or revoked.
error.invalid_response: The server did not return a supported Immich API response.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.missing_permission: The API key is missing one or more required read-only permissions.
error.no_sources: Select at least one image source.
error.wrong_account: The new host or API key belongs to a different Immich user.

abort.already_configured: This Immich user is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key was updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Immich server settings were updated successfully.

init.title: Configure Immich Gallery
init.description: Update the host, rotate the API key, select image sources, and control image rotation.

data.include_library: Random image from the whole library

data_description.url: HTTPS, local HTTP, Tailscale IP, and MagicDNS hostnames are supported. A trailing /api is accepted.
data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the current key.
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled for HTTPS unless the server deliberately uses a trusted private or self-signed certificate.
data_description.repeat_window: Remember this many images per source to reduce repeats. Use 0 to disable.
